description: Every user of this dapp controls their own wallet canister and upgrades it whenever they feel like it. These are the interface versions currently live in the fleet.

versions.headline: First release
versions.summary: Balance, owner, and a transfer that addresses a bare principal.

versions.headline: Adds wallet_version
versions.summary: Purely additive. Every v1.0.0 method keeps its exact signature.

versions.headline: Adds paged history
versions.summary: Adds transactions and the types it needs. Still additive over 1.0.0.

versions.headline: Repackage of 1.2.0
versions.summary: Renamed file, moved declaration, reordered, documented. Same contract, different source bundle.

versions.headline: Breaking: accounts and controllers
versions.summary: transfer takes an Account and gains two error cases; owner is replaced by controllers.

fleet.note: Never upgraded. Cold storage, and she likes it that way.
